**Step 7: All fixes cross-verified against source files**

Confirmed by reading every modified file: all 8 primary fixes plus the minor `EyeHeight` constant improvement are present and correct. The build compiles.

---

## Final Synthesis: Complete Project Status

The `tmp/mcgo/` project has been fully reviewed and all identified issues have been fixed. Here is the conclusive final report.

### Project: MiniCraft (Go Minecraft Clone)
- **Module:** `github.com/united-poo/mcgo`
- **Framework:** Ebitengine v2
- **Build:** `go build ./...` — **zero errors**

### Files on Disk (All Verified)
```
tmp/mcgo/
├── go.mod
├── go.sum
├── main.go                  (5.2 KB) — game loop, input, orchestration
├── block/block.go           (1.5 KB) — block types & properties
├── camera/camera.go         (2.5 KB) — ⚠️ unused camera struct
├── player/player.go         (3.9 KB) — player physics, collision, EyeHeight constant
├── player/interaction.go    (2.3 KB) — raycasting, block interaction
├── render/render.go         (10.7 KB) — software rasteriser, mesh builder, fillTriangle
└── world/
    ├── chunk.go             (2.0 KB) — chunk data & block storage
    ├── generator.go         (2.8 KB) — Perlin terrain generation
    └── world.go             (4.5 KB) — world management, LoadRadius, UnloadFarChunks
```

### All 8 Fixes + 1 Bonus Fix — Verified

| # | Fix | Severity | File | Status |
|---|-----|----------|------|--------|
| 1 | `Indices` changed `uint16→uint32` to prevent vertex overflow | **CRITICAL** | `render/render.go` | ✓ |
| 2 | Duplicate back-face culling removed (only 1 `if -nz >= 0` remains) | Medium | `render/render.go` | ✓ |
| 3 | `fillTriangle` bottom-half correct edges: `mx1`=y2→y3, `mx2`=y1→y3, `sx2` interpolated to y2 | **HIGH** | `render/render.go` | ✓ |
| 4 | Dead `if/else` branch removed from `collides()` | Low | `player/player.go` | ✓ |
| 5 | Redundant `castRay` wrapper unified to single `castRay()` returning `HitResult` | Low | `main.go` | ✓ |
| 6 | Right-click placement uses AABB overlap (0.3×1.8 hitbox) instead of point check | Low | `main.go` | ✓ |
| 7 | `UnloadFarChunks()` added; called in `Update()`; stale meshes cleaned | **HIGH** | `world/world.go`, `main.go` | ✓ |
| 8 | `render.go.fix` absent (fix applied directly to `render.go`) | Low | filesystem | ✓ |
| Bonus | `EyeHeight = 1.6` constant added to `player.go`, `main.go` uses `player.EyeHeight` | Low | `player/player.go`, `main.go` | ✓ |

### Remaining Caveats (Not Fixed — Intentional or Minor)

| Caveat | Location | Note |
|--------|----------|------|
| `camera` package is dead code (~110 lines, never imported) | `camera/camera.go` | Keep as scaffolding for future camera-relative rendering |
| `blockColors` duplicated in `render.go` vs `block.Properties` | `render/render.go` | Minor refactoring target — no functional impact |
| Water blocks invisible (skipped in mesh building) | `render/render.go` | Intentionally deferred for future transparency pass |
| `drawFog` empty stub | `render/render.go` | Reserved for future atmospheric effects |
| Tree placement height range narrow (30–34) | `world/generator.go` | Works for current flat terrain; revisit with varied terrain |
| No dirty-chunk optimisation list | `render/render.go`, `main.go` | Performance optimisation — not critical for current draw volumes |
| No `camera/camera.go` deletion | `camera/camera.go` | Out of scope for this bugfix pass |

### Build Verification
```
$ go build ./...
✓ success
```

The project is in a clean, compilable, and demonstrably improved state. All critical and high-severity issues from the original code review have been resolved. The codebase is ready for further feature development or gameplay iteration.
